content.theory:
Text is the heart of most pages. HTML gives you tags to structure it — not to style it (that's CSS's job), but to give each piece of text a **meaning**. ### Headings Six levels of heading, from `

` (most important) down to `

`: ```html

Page title

Section title

Sub-section

``` Use exactly one `

` per page — search engines use it to understand your page. ### Paragraphs `

` wraps a paragraph of text. The browser adds spacing around it automatically: ```html

This is one paragraph.

This is another paragraph.

``` ### Emphasis - `` makes text bold and signals *importance* - `` makes text italic and signals *emphasis* ```html

Warning: handle with care.

``` ### Line breaks `
` forces a line break. It is a void element — it has no closing tag: ```html

Line one
Line two

``` ### Inline vs block Block elements (`

`, `

`) start on a new line and take full width. Inline elements (``, ``, ``) flow within the text.
